title: Payout Methods On-Request Payout Amount
content:
An on-request payout from a Payout Methods method pays the method's undisbursed balance, which is every release, returned transfer and credit booked to the method less every transfer, rail fee, withholding and deduction booked against it, less the parts it holds back, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. It includes 60 percent of the earnings released to the method on the request date, none of the claim reimbursements credited to the method on the request date, and it leaves a float of USD 50.00 in the balance; whatever it does not include stays in the balance for the next scheduled run.

## Quantities

| Quantity | What it is, from the method's payout ledger |
|---|---|
| Undisbursed balance | All earnings released, transfers returned and credits booked to the method, less all transfers sent, rail fees charged, withholding taken and deductions applied on it |
| Fresh earnings | The earnings released to the method on the request date |
| Same-day claim reimbursements | The claim reimbursements credited to the method on the request date |
| Fresh-earnings holdback | The fresh earnings multiplied by the part of one hundred percent not covered by the share of fresh earnings the payout includes (60 percent included, so 40 percent held back) |
| Claim holdback | The same-day claim reimbursements multiplied by the part of one hundred percent not covered by the share of them the payout includes (none included, so all of them held back) |
| Float | USD 50.00, left in the balance |

## The amount

The on-request payout is the undisbursed balance less the fresh-earnings holdback, less the claim holdback, less the float. Both holdbacks and the float are subtracted from the balance unrounded; a payout that would come out below 0.00 is 0.00; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked examples (hypothetical ledgers)

**A.** A method's ledger shows USD 2400.00 of releases (USD 500.00 of them on the request date), USD 300.00 of credits (a claim reimbursement credited on the request date), USD 1500.00 of transfers, USD 10.00 of rail fees and USD 40.00 of deductions. The balance is USD 2700.00 less USD 1550.00, that is USD 1150.00. The fresh-earnings holdback is 40 percent of USD 500.00, USD 200.00; the claim holdback is the whole USD 300.00; the float is USD 50.00. The payout is USD 1150.00 less USD 200.00, less USD 300.00, less USD 50.00: **USD 600.00**.

**B. Rounding once.** Balance USD 1000.00, fresh earnings USD 333.33, no same-day claim reimbursement. The fresh-earnings holdback is USD 133.332, carried unrounded; USD 1000.00 less USD 133.332, less USD 50.00, is USD 816.668, rounded half up to **USD 816.67**.

**C. Floor at zero.** Balance USD 70.00, fresh earnings USD 60.00. The fresh-earnings holdback is USD 24.00; USD 70.00 less USD 24.00, less USD 50.00, would be below 0.00, so the payout is **USD 0.00** and the whole balance stays for the next scheduled run.
